items.title: Cedar dining pavilion, two recessed graphite heaters in the recess kit, in line running into the scene, centred over the dining table for eight
items.background: generated plate (no heater, no people, no lettering): covered terrace with cedar-board ceiling about 2.4 m, dining table for eight, garden at dusk (same plate and solved camera as pr-bg-white-ceiling-cedar-dining-f14)
items.source: CAD: '6kW heater and recess kit' (Series II 6 kW in the kit; the kit trim BMC-00659 is the only trim in the CAD, marked obsolete there). Two kits flush in the cedar boards, long axis with the boards running into the scene (owner: 'going into the image'), one behind the other, 2.2 m centre to centre (about 0.5 m between kits), centred left to right on the table and about 0.3 m behind its centre so the near kit stays whole in frame. Rendered in Blender (Cycles), composited by the content team; graphite graded to a neutral warm grey (R>=G>B), elements deep orange (about 200/119/61).
items.note: heaters dont look real...i would install them not one after the other but in the same config but paraller to each other...they should look Bromic..the glow is unreal..use the white heater
items.review_note: Redo of the cedar dining pavilion per owner: two graphite recessed in the recess kit, running into the scene, centred over the table.
